Laura Bennett: on with Northstar now — they scaled up dedicated pool and now ~10% requests 504/time out. can someone sanity check readiness?
Hiro Tanaka: checking. do we know if new pods were added recently?
Laura Bennett: yes, autoscaler 8->12 GPUs about 15 min ago.
Hiro Tanaka: i think readiness only checks HTTP health. model load can take a few min. gonna add a warmup gate + roll it.
Camila Reyes: pls make sure ticket has offering + symptom labels for reporting.
Laura Bennett: yup, opening SUP-4840
